purpose: Pilot evidence pass over two existing backlogs (Explore Europe wave-1 geography identities; SSPX worldwide pending place-detail cases). Demonstrates per-record verification with citations. Grants no publication, canonical name lock, map pin, Mass time or certification by itself; every record remains subject to the repository's human review gates.

method.geography: For each NEW_PLACE_IDENTITY_CANDIDATE, confirm the canonical name, settlement, country and (where an exact-site source gives it) coordinates, against the sanctuary's own site, Wikipedia infobox and/or GCatholic. Coordinates are recorded as CONFIRMED only when a cited source states them; otherwise COORDINATES_PENDING_EXACT_SITE.
method.directory: For each PENDING_PLACE_DETAIL_ADJUDICATION case, read the official SSPX map page and split the single 'place detail' bucket along two independent axes: (a) is there a usable street address, and (b) is there a predictable recurring Sunday Mass. Record each with the page's own 'last updated' date.
method.blocked_sources: Wikimedia Commons, Archive.org, Gallica and OpenStreetMap are not reachable from this session, so no coordinate was taken from OSM and no photograph was reviewed. Reachable: official sanctuary/diocese sites, Wikipedia, GCatholic, map.fsspx.org.
